assumptions: Piecewise linear 48V torque-speed interpolation; zero-speed peak and zero-torque480rpm endpoints are provisional joins. Absolute-speed bound applies identically to braking; no identified regenerative/four-quadrant map.
Below48V both speed axis and available torque scale by voltage/48; above48V no extra authority. This is provisional derating, not a measured voltage family.
Continuous torque interpolates1.2Nm at stall to1.6Nm at100rpm, then is capped by16.755160819Nm*rad/s mechanical power; also limited by the instantaneous torque-speed envelope.

Normalized overload rate is1/vendor-duration at table points, linearly interpolated in normalized excess torque. Blend stall and rotating rates by min(abs(rpm)/100,1). One common budget prevents switching operating points from resetting exposure.
Budget consumption integrates delivered load. At zero headroom applied torque is limited to continuous; inverse rate interpolation clips before integration so a step cannot overdraw budget.
Budget recovers only below half continuous load, linearly to1/60 per second atzero torque. This assumed cooldown is not a thermal-temperature model or hardware permission.

Episode resets initialize independent simulated motors at50percent headroom; selected resets leave all other motors' budgets continuous. Real control must persist measured thermal state, not apply episode reset semantics.
Phase current proxy is abs(delivered torque)/0.94 Arms, with sqrt(2) conversion toApk. It omits saturation/losses and is neither measured current nor a certified current limiter.
Metal housing-to-mount heat path confirmed qualitatively; equivalence to vendor plate unverified. Gains/friction/armature remain provisional pending leg-stand identification.
